evidence.anchor: Full validation passed with9437full-byte reads and90783reuses

checks: Every distinct unchanged identity hashes all bytes first.
Every reuse restats path/device/inode/size/mtime/ctime;read races fail closed.
Cache lasts one command only;no persistent trusted digest store.
Successor retains original apply/commit validation and separate receipts.
Final controller checks use unmodified uncached tools.
limitations: Ordinary local filesystem threat model;not protection against privileged metadata forgery.
Observed48.784second check is not a controlled timing benchmark or guaranteed speedup.
